town.label: Town
town.win: Wins when every Mafia member is gone.

mafia.label: Mafia
mafia.win: Wins when the Mafia equal or outnumber everyone else.

citizen.name: Citizen
citizen.summary: No night action. Wins with the Town through discussion and the vote.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.summary: Each night, protects one other player from an ordinary kill.

seer.name: Seer
seer.summary: Each night, checks one player and learns whether they read Town or Mafia.

agent.name: Agent
agent.summary: Carries the Mafia's shared kill each night.
